index.intro: Things you set for yourself. Nobody else's data is reachable from here.

account.intro: Your own display preferences. Nothing here is visible to anyone else.
account.loadError: Could not load your account settings. Nothing has been changed.
account.localeHint: A BCP-47 tag (e.g. {germanTag}, {britishTag}). Sets your date and number format, and your language where Calendry is translated — today German and English. Any other tag keeps its own date format and shows English. Overrides the institution default; leave empty to inherit.
account.localePlaceholder: e.g. de-DE, leave empty to inherit
account.localeError: Not a recognised locale. Try a tag like "de-DE" or "en-GB".
account.timezoneHint: Display and export only: an IANA zone name (e.g. {berlin}, {newYork}). It never changes where a session is drawn on the grid or how "today" is decided; the institution's own timezone governs all of that. Leave empty to leave it unset.
account.timezonePlaceholder: e.g. Europe/Berlin, leave empty to leave unset
account.timezoneError: Not a recognised timezone. Try a zone name like "Europe/Berlin".
account.saveError: Could not save. Nothing has been changed.

apiTokens.head: API tokens
apiTokens.hint: A bearer credential for scripts and integrations, restricted to whichever permissions you pick below and never more than you hold. Losing an access role narrows every token minted from it immediately. The secret is shown once, right after creation, and cannot be recovered afterwards; revoking a token takes effect straight away.
apiTokens.loadError: Could not load your API tokens.
apiTokens.issuedNote: Shown once. Use it as {header}. If it's lost, revoke this token and mint a new one.
apiTokens.grantsSummary: A token cannot hold more than you do: only permissions you currently hold are offered.
apiTokens.grantsExcluded: One permission you hold is deliberately absent: managing API tokens itself. A token can never mint or revoke a token, so a script would be refused it whatever you pick here.
apiTokens.enableAllAria: Enable the one permission you hold | Enable all {count} permissions you hold
apiTokens.disableAllAria: Disable the one permission you selected | Disable all {count} permissions you selected
apiTokens.presetsHint: Set the boxes for a common kind of token. A preset replaces the current selection, and never selects a permission you do not hold.
apiTokens.presetApplyAria: Apply {preset}: selects none of the {total} permissions in it, because you hold none of them | Apply {preset}: selects the one permission you hold of the {total} in it | Apply {preset}: selects the {count} permissions you hold of the {total} in it

readOnly.label: Read-only
readOnly.hint: Everything you may look at, and nothing that changes anything.

dataEntry.label: Import / data entry
dataEntry.hint: Read, create and update the records you manage. Nothing is deleted, and no session is placed.

scheduleAutomation.label: Schedule automation
scheduleAutomation.hint: Request solver runs, read proposals and violations, and re-place, swap or lock a session.

reporting.label: Export / reporting
reporting.hint: Read, plus the data exports and calendar-subscription links a reporting job needs.

apiTokens.noticeAllSelected: Selected the one permission you hold. | Selected all {count} permissions you hold.
apiTokens.noticeCleared: Cleared every permission from this token.
apiTokens.noticePresetFull: Applied {preset} in full: its one permission is selected. | Applied {preset} in full: all {count} of its permissions are selected.
apiTokens.noticePresetPartial: Applied {preset} partially: you hold {count} of the {total} permissions in it.
apiTokens.noticePresetMissing: The remaining one is not selected, because you do not hold it: {keys} | The remaining {count} are not selected, because you do not hold them: {keys}
apiTokens.noticePresetEmpty: Nothing selected: you do not hold the one permission {preset} needs. | Nothing selected: you hold none of the {count} permissions {preset} needs.
apiTokens.intro: A token lets a script act as you, limited to the permissions you pick below. It can never do more than you can: revoking one of your access roles narrows every token derived from it, immediately.

icsLinks.head: Calendar links
icsLinks.hint: A link an external calendar app (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar…) re-fetches on its own schedule, never downloaded once and forgotten. Unlike an API token this address stays visible here so you can re-copy it any time; deleting a link stops it immediately.
icsLinks.loadError: Could not load your calendar links.
icsLinks.scopeRolling: All terms · next {count} week | All terms · next {count} weeks

calendarLinks.intro: Subscribe an external calendar app (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar…) to your own schedule, or, if you may, to a specific Group's.

availability.intro: Days and blocks you cannot teach. What you submit here is {reviewed} before it affects any timetable: declaring unavailability is a hard rule for the scheduler, so it is not applied on your say-so alone.
availability.lecturerNote: The scheduler applies this when you are the {lecturer} of a session. Sessions you are attached to in another capacity are not affected yet.
availability.noGrid: This institution has no time grid configured, so blocks cannot be shown or checked. An administrator has to create one first.
availability.modeRecurringHint: Days or blocks you never teach
availability.submit: Submit for approval | Submit for approval | Submit {count} entries for approval
availability.submitted: Entry submitted for approval. Nothing is blocked until an administrator approves it. | {count} entries submitted for approval. Nothing is blocked until an administrator approves it.
availability.submittedPartly: Entry submitted. {failed} still on the grid; press again to retry. | {count} entries submitted. {failed} still on the grid; press again to retry.
availability.holidaySubmitted: Submitted for approval. Nothing is blocked until an administrator approves it.
availability.meterWithWeekScoped: {blocked} of {total} teaching slots blocked ({count} week-specific entry not counted) | {blocked} of {total} teaching slots blocked ({count} week-specific entries not counted)
availability.emptyHint: Nothing declared. The scheduler may place you at any time.
availability.effectPending: Not yet in effect: the scheduler can still place you here.
availability.effectApproved: In effect from the next schedule run.
availability.effectRejected: Not in effect. Remove it, or talk to an administrator.
availability.holidayRow: {term}: week {weeks}, away all day | {term}: weeks {weeks}, away all day
availability.removeApprovedAsk: Remove this approved window? It stops applying immediately, and a replacement has to be reviewed again.

preferences.intro: Days, times and kinds of room you would rather teach in. Unlike unavailability, a preference is a {soft} wish: it never blocks a placement, so it needs no approval and takes effect as soon as you save it.
preferences.weighed: {lead} Preferences are saved, visible to administrators, and read by the timetable generator, which tries to place your sessions on the days, blocks and kinds of room you choose. A preference always loses to a hard requirement, so treat it as a wish that is heard, not a guarantee.
preferences.notWeighedLead: Your institution does not currently weigh these.
preferences.notWeighed: {lead} Preferences are still saved and visible to administrators, but the timetable generator is not asked to act on them yet: an administrator switches this on for the whole institution. Saving now means it takes effect the moment they do.
preferences.noGrid: This institution has no time grid configured, so blocks cannot be shown. An administrator has to create one first. Day preferences below still work.
preferences.head: Your preferences
preferences.daysHelp: Leave everything unticked if you have no day preference.
preferences.blocksHelp: Leave everything unticked if you have no preference about the time of day.
preferences.roomTypesHelp: Rooms are matched on what they provide, so this is a wish for a KIND of room rather than for a particular one. Leave everything unticked if you do not mind.

teachingPattern.intro: How each module you lead is placed across the term. {spread} gives it a consistent weekly slot; {together} concentrates it into a short window instead. Neither is a guarantee: a pattern is weighed against every other rule the next time this institution generates a timetable, and it takes effect only once a tenant has switched the matching rule on.
teachingPattern.emptyHint: You are not listed as a lecturer on any module, so there is nothing to set a pattern for.
teachingPattern.patternMultiplePerDay: Multiple in a day (not available yet)

exams.intro: Ask for an exam on a module you lead. What you submit here is {reviewed} before it appears on any timetable, because an exam takes a room and an hour the schedule has to find, so it is not placed on your say-so alone.
exams.noModules: You are not listed as a lecturer on any module this term, so there is nothing to request an exam for.
exams.noExamKinds: This institution has no session kind marked as an exam yet, so an exam cannot be recorded under one. An administrator sets that on a session kind.
exams.examPeriodOne: This term's exam period is week {week}. That is where this institution has said its assessments belong; you can still ask for another week.
exams.examPeriodRange: This term's exam period is weeks {from}–{to}. That is where this institution has said its assessments belong; you can still ask for another week.
exams.noExamPeriod: This term has no exam period on the academic calendar, so there is no week to prefer. An administrator sets one under calendar periods.
exams.teachingWarning: This module has {placed} of its {required} sessions placed so far. The teaching plan is not fully scheduled yet, though that does not stop the exam request.
exams.listEmpty: You have not asked for an exam yet.

dataExport.intro: Everything this institution holds about you, as a spreadsheet or as JSON. This covers your own record only; an institution-wide export is a separate, permissioned capability.
